# vue-relative-rotation-chart

Vue 3 SVG component library for RRG-style relative rotation charts. Renderer only: your application supplies precomputed RS-Ratio and RS-Momentum series; the package handles quadrant visualization, animated tails, labels, controls, timeline playback, and PNG export.

## Boundary

- Does not fetch market prices
- Does not calculate RS-Ratio or RS-Momentum
- Does not generate trading signals or portfolio scores
- Independent implementation; not endorsed by RRG Research; no official JdK formula parity claim

## Input

`RrgRenderSeries[]` — one object per security with `ticker`, optional `label`/`name`, and `points[]` of `{ date, x, y, quadrant }` (ISO dates, sorted).

## Framework

Vue 3 peer dependency (^3.5.0). SVG rendering via Vue templates; D3 used for math only.

## Features

- Leading / Weakening / Lagging / Improving quadrants
- Configurable tails, spatial-bin labels, viewport modes (fit / max / center)
- Optional `RrgPlaybackControls`, `RrgChartControlsPanel`, series visibility helpers
- PNG export via chart ref

## Install

npm install vue-relative-rotation-chart
